title: Syntheses, structures and magnetic properties of mononuclear, dinuclear and tetranuclear dysprosium(III) complexes based on azotetrazole-3-hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid

material_class.structural_family: nine-coordinate mononuclear Dy(III) complex with three tridentate HATNA ligands

synthesis.procedure: H3ATNA (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) and triethylamine (33 mg, 0.33 mmol) were dissolved in methanol (5 mL) and DMF (0.5 mL) and stirred for 5 min. Dy(CH3COO)3·4H2O (0.021 g, 0.05 mmol) was added, the mixture was stirred for 2 h and filtered, and the filtrate was slowly evaporated to give block red crystals of 1.
synthesis.time: stirred 5 min, then 2 h after metal addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate slowly evaporated to give block red crystals

properties.summary: Mononuclear 1 shows χMT consistent with one Dy(III) ion, magnetization of 6.53 Nβ at 70 kOe, and no slow magnetic relaxation above 2 K in 0 or 1000 Oe dc fields.

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 70 kOe; low-temperature M vs H (2–5 K range reported for field-dependence plots)

source_locations.location: experimental synthesis of 1 (markdown heading order mixed with H3ATNA)

material_class.structural_family: hydroxyl-bridged dinuclear Dy2 cluster (nine- and eight-coordinate Dy sites)

synthesis.procedure: H3ATNA (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) and ethylenediamine (28 mg, 0.47 mmol) were dissolved in methanol (5 mL) and DMF (5 mL) and stirred for 5 min. Dy(CH3COO)3·4H2O (0.041 g, 0.1 mmol) was added, the mixture was stirred for 2 h and filtered, and the filtrate was slowly evaporated to give block red crystals of 2.
synthesis.time: stirred 5 min, then 2 h after metal addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate slowly evaporated to give block red crystals

properties.summary: Dinuclear 2 shows χMT consistent with two Dy(III) ions, magnetization 11.20 Nβ at 70 kOe, and frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility in zero dc field (no well-defined χ″ peaks; rough ΔE/kB = 0.84 K).

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE/kB
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; estimated from ln(χ″/χ′) vs T−1 assuming one relaxation process

measurements.name: pre-exponential factor τ0
measurements.conditions: same Debye-type estimate as ΔE/kB for 2

material_class.structural_family: carboxylate-linked tetranuclear Dy4 cluster described as two dinuclear fragments

synthesis.procedure: H3ATNA (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) and triethylamine (50 mg, 0.50 mmol) were dissolved in acetonitrile (10 mL) and DMF (1 mL) and stirred for 5 min. Dy(CH3COO)3·4H2O (0.041 g, 0.1 mmol) was added, the mixture was stirred for 2 h and filtered, and the filtrate was slowly evaporated to give needle red crystals of 3.
synthesis.time: stirred 5 min, then 2 h after metal addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate slowly evaporated to give needle red crystals

properties.summary: Tetranuclear 3 shows χMT consistent with four Dy(III) ions, magnetization 22.78 Nβ at 70 kOe, and slow magnetic relaxation in zero dc field without well-defined χ″ peaks (rough ΔE/kB = 5.03 K), attributed in part to QTM.

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE/kB
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; estimated from ln(χ″/χ′) vs T−1 assuming one relaxation process

measurements.name: pre-exponential factor τ0
measurements.conditions: same Debye-type estimate as ΔE/kB for 3

source_locations.location: CCDC JEWNEI / 2207287 matched to Dy4 solvate formula
